newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVM asks bolsa to explain Thursday's trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVM asks bolsa to explain Thursday's trade.

text.p: Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) said it has asked the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) to provide explanation on Thursday's session, which was marked by heavy trade and high volatility.
"We found that there was an unusual movement in the last hour of the session," said a CVM spokesman.

The Sao Paulo bourse closed 1.09 percent higher on Thursday after seesawing earlier, while players liquidated their futures index contracts on Brazil's futures exchange Bolsa de Mercadorias e de Futuros (BM&F).
Market volume was over $1.0 billion, the highest volume in a single session since September 1994, discounting the options settlements dates.
The CVM expects to hear from Bovespa by Monday, when options expire.
